title: Cosmo sees the pictures: a vision agent model, and tool facts it plans from
description: Fabio 2026-10-19. Two halves, one goal: Cosmo works things out himself. (1) Cosmo's chat model is text-only (DeepSeek V4 Flash) and sees pictures only as the describer's text, so it cannot compare identity between two pictures, judge its own results, or take one named quality from a reference. Pulled out of MPI-1134 Phase 5b. (2) Each op states what it can change (shape, content, pose) where it is picked, plus one planning habit, never route recipes. Brief: brief.md.
